entities.summary: Álvaro Antonio García Pérez, known professionally as Álvaro Morte, is a Spanish actor. He gained worldwide recognition for playing the role of 'The Professor' in the television series Money Heist. Morte briefly played Logain Ablar in the high fantasy series The Wheel of Time (2021–2023) and Adolfo Suárez in the historical drama miniseries The Anatomy of a Moment.
